LESSON: SELF- ESTEEM ASSESSMENT

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Social Studies Personal Management
Topic 1.2: Self- Esteem Assessment

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Self- Esteem Assessment
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How does self- esteem affect my holistic development?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain the contribution of self- esteem on their holistic development
2. identify a problem/gap in the community
3. appreciate the need to offer solutions to the gaps/challenges in the community

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: explain the contribution of self- esteem on their holistic development

Teach
• Today’s focus: explain the contribution of self- esteem on their holistic development.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “explain the contribution of self- esteem on their holistic development” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "explain the contribution of self- esteem on their holistic development" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: identify a problem/gap in the community

Teach

• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “identify a problem/gap in the community” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify a problem/gap in the community" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 3: appreciate the need to offer solutions to the gaps/challenges in the community

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate the need to offer solutions to the gaps/challenges in the community.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate the need to offer solutions to the gaps/challenges in the community” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate the need to offer solutions to the gaps/challenges in the community” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate the need to offer solutions to the gaps/challenges in the community" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: explain the contribution of self- esteem on their holistic development
• Model 2: identify a problem/gap in the community
• Model 3: appreciate the need to offer solutions to the gaps/challenges in the community

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: explain the contribution of self- esteem on their holistic development
2. Practise: identify a problem/gap in the community
3. Practise: appreciate the need to offer solutions to the gaps/challenges in the community

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Self- Esteem Assessment.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How does self- esteem affect my holistic development?
2. How does one determine some gaps/ needs in the community?
3. Why is it necessary to make adequate preparations before embarking on a project?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• explain the contribution of self- esteem on their holistic development
• identify a problem/gap in the community
• appreciate the need to offer solutions to the gaps/challenges in the community

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
